name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
label: Quest
description: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this report back to Lexlort. It will redeem my good name and will surely give the K.E.F. A strategic advantage in dealing with these orcs.
Come with you? I've got way too much work to do. Get going, they need these reports as soon as possible!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I've got to hand it to her; she's managed to weasel her way out of another sticky situation! These reports will prove to be invaluable in our dealings with the Blackrock orcs.
Of course, you will be rewarded for your hard work.
